Name: (CP x AT) Starry Trees
Author: Sodacchi
Description:
[size=5][b]1.6+[/b][/size]

Content Patcher now allows to add new items directly without Json Assets.

[size=4][u][b]SEASONAL version[/b][/u][/size]
[spoiler]
[size=3][b]WHERE TO BUY THE TREE:[/b]
﻿You need to buy it from Robin. [/size]

[b]DETAILS:[/b]
﻿There's one tree to buy which changes every season.
﻿ ﻿2 [[b][color=#e06666]AT[/color][/b]] variations. [color=#b6b6b6][size=2](see images)[/size][/color]

[b]﻿﻿INSTALL:[/b]
﻿﻿ [color=#f4f4f4]- [/color][color=#e69138]Install SMAPI, Content Patcher and Alternative Textures.[/color]
﻿﻿﻿- ﻿[size=2][i](Delete old versions if you are updating them.)[/i][/size]
- Download the mod and extract it to your [i]/Mods[/i] folder.
﻿- Run the game using SMAPI.

[/spoiler]

[size=4][u][b]NON-SEASONAL version[/b][/u][/size]
[spoiler]
[size=3][b]WHERE TO BUY THE TREES:[/b]
﻿You need to buy them from Robin. [/size]

[b]DETAILS:[/b]
﻿There are all 4 default trees, they don't change when season changes.
﻿ ﻿8 [[b][color=#e06666]AT[/color][/b]] variations. [color=#b6b6b6][size=2](see images)[/size][/color]

[b]﻿﻿INSTALL:[/b]
﻿﻿ [color=#f4f4f4]- [/color][color=#e69138]Install SMAPI, Content Patcher and Alternative Textures.[/color]
﻿﻿﻿- ﻿[size=2][i](Delete old versions if you are updating them.)[/i][/size]
- Download the mod and extract it to your [i]/Mods[/i] folder.
﻿- Run the game using SMAPI.

[/spoiler]
[size=3][b]AVAILABLE RECOLORS:[/b][/size]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor
[/url]
[s]                                                                             
[/s]
[size=4][i] ﻿﻿If you have any issues let me know!
[/i][/size]
